context: WWE's first SmackDown in Italy; week after Clash in Italy (Bologna). KOTR/QOTR R1 continues (Raquel + Dominik advance). Spine: (1) Cody/Gunther/Sami 3-way over the tainted Clash finish -> rematch booked (6/19 Kansas City, Gunther picks the stip, revealed 6/12); (2) Chad Gable's lucha-redemption arc begins. Outlet-backfill (no live markers): WrestleView, PWMania, WWE.com, TheSportster, Ring Report, WrestlingInc, Cageside, WrestleZone. FLAGS: Cody 'sausage maker' line WrestleView-only; B-Fab interference (M3) PWMania-only; War Raiders/AAA-tag challenge to Priest&Truth thin-sourced; Rhea 'injury' = storyline non-compete, NO injury reported; Women's Tag NOT captured (WrestleView 'captured' is an outlier error — attack only).

segments.outcome: Gunther opened by ripping apart the announce tables, demanding the title and 'justice' for the Clash finish (his foot was under the bottom rope on the losing pin). Cody Rhodes came out, ADMITTED the foot was under the rope but framed controversial finishes as the business, and offered an impromptu title match. Sami Zayn interrupted ('this is why our friendship is in the state it's in'; 'the biggest threat to your championship'). 3-way brawl: Cody inadvertently sent Sami into Gunther who dropped Sami; Cody offered a hand -> SAMI REJECTED IT.
segments.notes: The rarer beat: the king CONCEDES the crown is taint-touched on the mic. Two prosecutions of Cody's legitimacy from opposite ends (Gunther: you never earned it; Sami: you keep denying me). The rejected hand is the image of the deepening Cody/Sami fracture.

segments.outcome: Queen of the Ring R1 Fatal 4-Way: Raquel Rodriguez def. Bayley, Jacy Jayne & Kiana James via Tejana Bomb on Kiana (after James/Jayne bickering). Raquel ADVANCES. Post-match: Giulia attacked Kiana James over the ropes-spot blame -> alliance fractured.
segments.notes: Raquel through to QOTR SF. The Giulia/Kiana split is the forward seed.

segments.outcome: Talla Tonga (w/ Solo & Tama) def. Royce Keys via chokeslam w/ MFT interference. Post-match: MFTs beat down Keys -> R-Truth save -> Damian Priest pulled Truth to safety; Priest & Truth argued about whether to help Keys.
segments.register: Shadow-Bloodline asserts / SD tag champ drifting
segments.notes: Priest distancing from the MFT orbit (saved Truth, not Keys). Seeds the priest-mft-drift watch.

segments.outcome: Chad Gable (unmasked as El Grande Americano at Noche 6/6) appeared as himself, babyface. Apologized to Rey Fenix for taking the lucha character in bad faith to mock the culture — said the longer he wore the mask in Mexico it 'stopped being a joke and became a responsibility,' called it 'a harsh lesson,' asked forgiveness. Fenix forgave but warned: 'Remember, I'm not the only one you offended.' Italian crowd chanted Gable's name.
segments.notes: Opens the redemption chain (Fenix -> Penta -> Rey across 6/5-6/8). The 'Shorty G return-with-rub' call pays off (returns as himself). The mask worn in bad faith converted the wearer.

segments.outcome: Ring promo: Rhea (champ) on moving past Jade; Charlotte vowed to take the title via QOTR; Tiffany wants the Women's title; Jade came for Clash revenge. Aldis ruled Rhea 'unfit to compete' -> booked Charlotte & Tiffany (reluctant partners) vs Jade & partner.
segments.notes: Rhea held out as storyline non-compete (NO injury reported). The division is stacked, not cycled — Charlotte's motive still unresolved.

segments.outcome: Jade Cargill & Michin def. Charlotte Flair & Tiffany Stratton — Jade pinned Tiffany (Jaded). (B-Fab involvement PWMania-only.)
segments.notes: The reluctant Charlotte/Tiffany pairing loses; Jade's group stands tall going into the title queue.

segments.outcome: Fatal Influence (Jacy Jayne, Gigi Dolin, Fallon Henley + Lainey Reid) jumped Women's Tag Champions Brie Bella & Paige and posed with the belts. NO TITLE CHANGE — attack/statement only. (Segment moved from arena/crowd to backstage last-minute per Brie's podcast.)
segments.notes: Opens the women's-tag title chase; WrestleView's 'captured' claim is an outlier error — champs retained.

segments.outcome: Ricky Saints def. Carmelo Hayes via rollup with a handful of tights (after Hayes near-count-out at 9).
segments.register: subtle heel-lean for the ascending Saint
segments.notes: Saints steals it with the cheat — a textured win for a still-coded babyface.

segments.outcome: Lash Legend (w/ Nia Jax) def. Chelsea Green via Lash Extension; Nia interference. Tiffany had declined to back Green up.
segments.notes: Tiffany helps on her own clock only — the conditional-patronage beat continues (Green left to handle it solo, loses).

segments.outcome: Video package: Finn Balor announced as SmackDown's newest acquisition; set for KOTR R1 next week (6/12) vs Royce Keys, LA Knight & Jey Uso.
segments.notes: The 6/1 single-sourced 'Balor -> SmackDown' tease pays off and is now confirmed.

segments.outcome: Solo Sikoa cornered Royce Keys — claimed he's Keys' 'only family now' (Fatu's gone to Roman, Priest distanced), warned Keys not to be difficult 'or Solo will make this difficult.' (MFT 'war' recruitment.)
segments.notes: Solo recruiting for a 'war' (WarGames-coded, NOT booked); the gutted MFTs lean on Keys.

segments.outcome: GM Nick Aldis delivered the rematch terms to Cody: Gunther's 'legal team' accepts the rematch ONLY if Gunther picks the stipulation. Match = 6/19 SmackDown (Kansas City); Gunther reveals the stip on 6/12 SmackDown (Providence).
segments.register: the terms of redemption dictated by the challenger
segments.notes: The Imperator dictates the conditions of his own rematch (Scroll 007). Aldis is the GM of record (a Ring Report Pearce/legal mention is an error).

segments.outcome: King of the Ring R1 Fatal 4-Way: Dominik Mysterio def. Trick Williams, Bron Breakker & Damian Priest via Frog Splash on Priest (Judgment Day numbers: JD McDonagh ate South of Heaven; Liv Morgan distraction/low-blow per PWMania; Dom pulled the ref). Dom ADVANCES, told Oba Femi to 'count your days.'
segments.notes: Opens the Dom vs Oba KOTR semifinal. Judgment Day numbers carry Dom through.
